skills.name: Early humans and Africa, the cradle of humankind

worked_example.problem: Why did early humans often live near rivers and lakes?
steps: People and animals need water every day.
Animals came to drink, so hunting was easier, and plants grew well near water.
So rivers and lakes gave water and food.
worked_example.answer: For water and food (animals to hunt and plants to gather).

cards.idea: Africa is the cradle of humankind: the oldest human ancestors were found there.
example: “Lucy” was found in Ethiopia; Toumaï was found in Chad, Cameroon’s neighbour.

cards.idea: Fossils are the remains of very old bones turned to stone. Their dates are estimates, so we say “about”.
Early humans lived near water, in the savanna, and in caves and rock shelters.
example: A cave gave shelter from rain and wild animals.

check.prompt: Where did early humans often live?

right.text: in the savanna, where there were animals to hunt

wrong.text: on the tops of high, bare mountains
wrong.explain: They needed water and food nearby.

wrong.text: in the middle of deserts far from water

pick.t: Olduvai Gorge, famous for Homo habilis, is here
pick.why: Tanzania: Olduvai Gorge, famous for Homo habilis, is here.

pick.t: the “Turkana Boy” (Homo erectus) was found here
pick.why: Kenya: the “Turkana Boy” (Homo erectus) was found here.
South Africa: the Sterkfontein caves are here.

misconceptions.explain: Not that country. Read the list of finds again.

right.text: the remains of a very old living thing, often turned to stone

wrong.text: a new kind of stone tool
wrong.explain: A tool is made by people; a fossil is a remain of a living thing.

wrong.text: a story about the first people
wrong.explain: That is a myth or oral tradition.
A painting is made by people; a fossil is a remain.

wrong.text: a modern skeleton in a hospital

questions.prompt: Why is Africa called the cradle of humankind?

right.text: The oldest fossils of human ancestors have been found there.

wrong.explain: Asia is larger. The reason is the oldest fossils.

wrong.text: It has the most people today.
wrong.explain: Asia has the most people. The reason is the oldest fossils.
The reason is the oldest fossils of human ancestors.
The phrase is about human ancestors.

questions.prompt: Why did early humans settle near rivers and lakes?

right.text: for drinking water and food from animals and plants

wrong.explain: They needed water and food to survive.

wrong.text: because rivers were warm in winter
wrong.explain: The reasons were water and food.
